selection_rationale: Both lemmas were reviewed as C2A class-only entries before the v11 benchmark family and are already admitted by the generic C2A class-past architecture. They are the two members of the existing 11-lemma cohort not used in the v14-v17 target registries. After v17, class-level past authorizes 1sg, 1pl, 2sg, 2pl and 3pl while 3sg masculine remains explicitly deferred. The two targets are fixed before any external lookup of their 3sg masculine past surfaces.
notes: This file intentionally contains no target surface answers. Its purpose is to create a Git-verifiable pre-answer checkpoint for a narrow C2A 3sg-masculine-past experiment. General pre-v18 development evidence already documents C2A 1sg/3sg-masculine syncretism, but no 3sg-masculine past surface for aammusi or abhi is asserted here.
